manualReview: Explicit source/documentation/binary allowlist; no private workspace history.
Five private-key header matches in the official AP are NUL-terminated parser delimiter strings, not PEM key bodies.
Only synthetic fixture account fields; runtime session keys are not included.
Vendor OTA contains generic components, not owner factory/calibration/settings dumps.
Public build disables the private-baseline USB writer before connecting.
Owner-approved image derivatives visually inspected; original images remain private.
Phone status/navigation and Gallery UI cropped out; no AI retouching; EXIF/GPS/XMP/IPTC/comments/thumbnails removed.
Owner-approved finished English review matches the verified export; only public title/date and codec metadata; private production manifests excluded.
limits: Pattern scanning and manual review are not a mathematical guarantee about arbitrary binaries.
